name: dsh-tui-app
description: Out-of-tree full-screen Ink app bundle for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.test:ac:m3: vitest run tests/m3 && node scripts/ac4.mjs && node scripts/ac5.mjs
scripts.test:ac:m4: vitest run tests/m4 tests/m2/cjk-markdown.spec.ts tests/m2/property.spec.ts && node scripts/ac6.mjs && node scripts/ac7.mjs
scripts.test:ac:all: npm run test:ac && npm run test:ac:m2 && npm run test:ac:m3 && npm run test:ac:m4 && npm run test:pty:m4
scripts.test:gate:alpha: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha-host.ps1 npm run test:ac:all && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha-host.ps1 npm run test:timer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha-host.ps1 npm run test:ask-user && node scripts/restore-flat-credentials.mjs
scripts.test:gate:alpha2: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha2-host.ps1 npm run test:ac:all && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha2-host.ps1 npm run test:timer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha2-host.ps1 npm run test:ask-user && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-alpha2-host.ps1 npm run test:team:pty && node scripts/restore-flat-credentials.mjs --exact .pre-0.2.0
scripts.test:gate:browser: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-browser-host.ps1 npm run test:ac:all && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-browser-host.ps1 npm run test:timer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-browser-host.ps1 npm run test:ask-user && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-browser-host.ps1 npm run test:team:pty && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/with-browser-host.ps1 npm run test:browser:pty && node scripts/restore-flat-credentials.mjs --exact .pre-0.2.0
